description: CsNaICl crystallizes in the tetragonal P4/mmm space group. Cs is bonded to two equivalent I and four equivalent Cl atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing CsI₂Cl₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Both Cs-I bond lengths are 3.79 Å. All Cs-Cl bond lengths are 3.37 Å. Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent I atoms. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.37 Å. I is bonded to two equivalent Cs and four equivalent Na atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ICs₂Na₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. Cl is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent Cs atoms.
